fields.label: Stock held for Sales Orders
fields.description: Stock in VV Puram - IND that is held for a Sales Order (a draft or submitted Pick List, goods at an embroidery jobber, raw material bought for the order) can't be delivered, invoiced, transferred, issued, reconciled away or returned for anything else, and a receipt that brought it in can't be cancelled. The users below, Administrator and System Manager may go past this: they get a warning, and the document records it in a comment.

fields.label: May use held stock
fields.description: Only for corrections. Everyone else is stopped with a message naming the order and Pick List that hold the stock.

The app's automatic updates (a customer's first POS Invoice, a merchandiser taking a customer on approval) are not affected.
